ayah.ar: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَإِن يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَآدَّ لِفَضْلِهِۦ ۚ يُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayah.en: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He intends for you good, then there is no repeller of His bounty. He causes it to reach whom He wills of His servants. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful

phrases.en: And if Allah should touch you with adversity,
there is no remover of it except Him;
and if He intends for you good,
then there is no repeller of His bounty.

phrases.ar: يُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ
phrases.en: He causes it to reach whom He wills of His servants.
phrases.simple: يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ۚ

phrases.en: And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
